_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Nekk d uɣerbani {player_id}, ar tturarɣ {num_rounds} n tɣulin n Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Ḍariɣ ${pool} iɣunab n kraygat tɣult sɣur-k d uɣerbani {other_id}.

Assuɣsi:
  - Ssuɣs tɣawsa: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ma d yiwen iɣunab → Nekk ar tɣamaɣ $(pool - X), uɣerbani nniḍen ar tɣama $X
  - Ma d yiwen ur iɣunab → Kraygat ar tɣama $0
  - Amzray: [Offer: $3]  neɣ  'Ḥsabɣ d akken d amḍan. [Offer: $5]'

Assider:
  - Ṣṣay tɣawsa s [Accept] neɣ [Reject]
  - Amzray: 'Ḥsabɣ d akken d amḍan. [Accept]'
            'Ur d yiwen amḍan. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Tafra {round_number} teggḍa! ---
Anegzem {proposer_id} d amseɣẓaḍ, Anegzem {responder_id} d amsenɣẓaḍ.
round.offer: Tɣult {round_number}: Uɣerbani {proposer_id} iɣunab ${offer} i uɣerbani {responder_id} (ar tɣama ${keep}).
round.accepted: Anegzem {responder_id} yessufɣeḍ! Tafra {round_number} tessɛu: Anegzem {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Anegzem {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Iɣewwaṛen imaynuten: Anegzem 0: ${total_0}, Anegzem 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Anegzem {responder_id} yekkes lḥeqq! Tafra {round_number} tessɛu: Snen yakk fell-asen $0. Iɣewwaṛen zemren ad ilin: Anegzem 0: ${total_0}, Anegzem 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⴽⵔ ⵓⵎⵙⵙⵓⴼⵖ ⵢⴰⵜ ⵜⵏⴰⴼⵓⵜ ⵙ ⵓⵡⵉⴽⵉ ⵏ [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴷ ⵉⴳ ⵡⴰⵜⵉⴳ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⵓⵎⵔ ⴰⵎⴹⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴷⴰⴽⴽⵡⵍ.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Lḥeqq ara ad yili gar $0 d ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⴼⵔⴽ ⵉⵍⴰⵏ ⵜⴰⵖⴹⴼⵜ.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Asenmel aɣerman ad yessufɣeḍ [Accept] neɣ [Reject] lḥeqq.

outcome.win: Uɣerbani {winner} iɣunab s ${winner_total} ḍari vs uɣerbani {loser} s ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: ⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎⵏ ⵉⵎⵓⵔⴰⵔⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⵡ ⵥⴹⴰⵕⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵖⵔⵉⵏ ${total} ⴳ ⵓⵎⵎⴰⵣ.
